newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed prices rally on unseasonal rains.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed prices rally on unseasonal rains.

text.p: Castorseed prices recovered from an early weakness as reports of unseasonal rains in producer states sparked short-covering, floor sources said.
March delivery bounced back to 1,174/1,175 rupees per quintal after an initial drop from 1,175/1,176 rupees to 1,166/1,167 rupees amid sluggish overseas enquiries.
"Unseasonal rains in the producing centres has curtailed new crop arrivals and may to some extent affect the size of the new crop," one operator said.
Meanwhile groundnut oil slid from 245 rupees to 242/243 rupees per 10 kg on sluggish physical buying as well as higher arrivals of imported palm oil and imported sunflower oil at the Bombay port.

Imported palm oil was quiet at 284/285 rupees per 10 kg on the resale basis and at the rate of 286 rupees for the direct delivery by importers. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil fell by 5 rupees to 515/520 rupees per 15 kg.
